name: v2026.15.0-beta.1
body:
Nym VPN v2026.15.0-beta.1 application and core binaries. This release is for all platforms, except Android (Google Play)

## 🚀 What's New
### 🛠️ Core

#### Added

- Add a bridge mode (auto, on, off) in place of the QUIC on/off setting (config v14). Auto connects over plain WireGuard first and alternates with the bridge on each retry
- Add `delete_account` command that deletes the account through the VPN API and removes local account data (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6790)
- Add a `SetBridgeMode` gRPC call and `vpnc tunnel set --bridge-mode` to choose the bridge mode (auto, on or off), replacing the `SetEnableBridges` gRPC call and `vpnc tunnel set --circumvention-transports`, which are removed (breaking: an older desktop app calling `SetEnableBridges` against this daemon gets UNIMPLEMENTED)
- Add `--wait` to `nym-vpnc reconnect` to block until the tunnel has reconnected or failed (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6849)
- `bridge_transports.enabled` feature flag (`FeatureFlags::bridge_transports_enabled`, uniffi `is_bridge_transports_enabled`) for the v2 bridge transports (TLS and SSH after QUIC). Bridges and QUIC do not depend on it
- `BridgeAddress` in the connection data carries the bridge transport in use (`transport`: QUIC, TLS or SSH)
- When the `bridge_transports.enabled` feature flag is on, a bridge connection tries QUIC for 5 seconds, then races the entry gateway's TLS and SSH bridges. The firewall allows only the bridges being tried, QUIC over UDP and TLS and SSH over TCP, in both the connecting and connected states. With the flag off or unset, QUIC only as before
- Add support for custom secure DNS. Supported protocols: TLS, HTTPS, QUIC, HTTP/3. Currently only cli supports that. No UI support yet. (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6876)

#### Changed

- Read gateway bridge transports from `transports_v2` (falling back to `transports` for older bridges), skipping transport types this build does not know, so gateways can advertise TLS, SSH and future transports without breaking the gateway list
- `nym-vpnc reconnect` now fails when the daemon rejects the reconnect because the tunnel is not set to connect (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6849)
- [iOS] Flush DNS when changing ad-block setting by reconnecting the tunnel (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6866)
- `nym-vpnc dns set` no longer removes all custom DNS. Use `nym-vpnc dns clear` instead (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6876)
- `nym-vpnc dns set` no longer accepts positional argument to configure plain DNS. Use one of the following arguments instead: `--plain`, `--tcp` or `--udp` (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6876)

#### Fixed

- Fix the gateway mixnet score being decoded from the general score in the gRPC conversion (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6859)
- Fix `nym-vpnc connect --wait` waiting forever when the tunnel is already connected (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6849)
- Fix `nym-vpnc` `--wait` options missing fast tunnel state changes and reporting success when the daemon's event stream ends (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6849)
- SOCKS5 proxy no longer misses tunnel state updates and reacts to them immediately instead of polling every 2 seconds. Fixed the SOCKS5 proxy sometimes staying on after the VPN disconnected, or turning off right after being enabled (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6850)
- Stop the internal SOCKS5 mixnet client and its listener on `127.0.0.1:1081` when SOCKS5 is disabled, so the next enable starts a new mixnet client instead of reusing the first session's (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6854)
- Enabling SOCKS5 now fails when the SOCKS5 address is already in use, instead of reporting success while nothing listens on it (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6854)


#### Changed

- Count bandwidth usage locally and fetch remote gateway quota less frequently to improve mobile battery usage (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6803)

#### Fixed

- Stop emitting the same tunnel state twice while connecting the tunnel (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6852)

### 🤖 Android app

#### Added
- Hide overlay windows on sensitive screens (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6780)
- `playtest` build type for local Google Play billing testing (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6855)

#### Changed
- Open server list instantly with saved servers and updates in the background (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6799)
- Google Play build keeps plan selection, renewal and subscription management on Google Play billing (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6855)

#### Fixed
- Restore residential icon on exit servers list (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6793)
- Show connected server country before server list loads (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6858)
- Fix mixed "your country" subtitles after picking Auto (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6858)

### 🐧🪟 Windows & Linux apps

#### Fixed

- Home screen: hide the server quality bar until a gateway is selected (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/issues/6557)

## 📦 Core Components Overview

- `nym-vpnd`: Background daemon service managed via the UI app or CLI.
- `nym-vpnc`:  Command-line interface (CLI) to control the daemon (`nym-vpnd`).
- `nym-socks5-proxy`: SOCKS5 proxy handling geo-exclusion routing.
- `nym-diagnostic`: System information and network troubleshooting tool.
- `nym-setup`: macOS helper tool for system service configuration.

name: v2026.14.0
body:
Nym VPN v2026.14.0 application and core binaries.

## 🚀 What's New
### 🛠️ Core

#### Added

- Expose free trial eligibility (`trialEligible` from the active subscription endpoint) to mobile clients through the account controller (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6701)
- Expose the Apple introductory-offer eligibility token (`subscription/apple/intro-offer-eligibility`) to the iOS client through the account controller, for StoreKit's `introductoryOfferEligibility` purchase option (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6701)
- Publish the app update policy, with optional per-platform overrides, from discovery so clients can ask for or require an update (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6450)
- Add `polkit-1-auth-agent` to deb package dependencies to ensure that components used for graphical password prompts are installed alongside (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6502)
- Add `nym-vpnc completions <shell>` to generate shell completions, and install bash, zsh and fish completions with the macOS, deb and AUR packages (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6735)

#### Fixed

- Enter error state on failure to configure local DNS resolver (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6629)
- Auto selection no longer treats US states as separate jurisdictions: "exclude my country" and the entry/exit country check now compare whole countries only
- Fix panic in logging system initialization (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6674)
- Rotate logs on iOS and Android on per session basis (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6679)
- Remove SQLite WAL and shared-memory files (-wal, -shm) along with their databases when wiping local storage. (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6706)
- Resolve the nyxd, nym-api and VPN API hostnames concurrently when connecting, so a blocked encrypted DNS no longer adds its timeout once per lookup
- Fix F-Droid reproducible builds by omitting the Sentry DSN and sccache wrapper from the F-Droid build (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6692)
- Blacklist the gateway that failed registration, entry or exit, instead of always blaming the entry, so retries no longer re-select a failing exit. The connection attempts exceeded message no longer suggests turning on QUIC

#### Security

- Decide the route for each resolved IP address individually in the geo-exclusion proxy. Previously, if any address resolved for a domain was excluded, all of that domain’s addresses were routed outside the tunnel. (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6705)

### 🤖 Android app

#### Added

- Show the app update prompt on Android. A dismissible prompt can be closed; a required one cannot and blocks new tunnels (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6451)

#### Changed
- Keystore-bound auth with PIN fallback for passphrase and subscription (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6727)
- Mask passphrase input with temporary reveal (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6727)
- Sync network stats preference to core, off by default (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6727)
- Flatten server list into per-row lazy items (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6736)
- Move row building and expand state to ViewModel (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6736)
- Free trial is offered only when the backend reports the account as trial eligible: the Play offer is selected explicitly (trial offer vs. regular offer) and the trial label is hidden whenever the regular offer will be launched
- Onboarding plan page and plan screens share one trial eligibility check (no stored account = eligible, otherwise the backend answer) and show a trial only when Play also offers one; the trial length comes from Play instead of a hardcoded 7 days, and the onboarding fallback pricing no longer claims a trial
- Purchase flow launches the base plan (never an intro-discount offer) when no trial applies, and reports an error instead of hanging when no base plan is available
- Trial labels and plan pricing no longer shift the layout when eligibility or Play pricing resolve
- Update and improve error-message copy (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6749)

#### Fixed
- Fix unclickable nodes in large countries (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6736)
- Show the daily allowance reset time in the local time zone (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6497)
- Persist onboarding data-sharing consent through AppSettings so the welcome sheet and Settings stay in sync (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6469)
- Correct the welcome-sheet consent toggles for error reports and usage analytics to match Settings (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6470)

### 🐧🪟 Windows & Linux apps

#### Added

- Show the update dialog on Linux, macOS and Windows when the app or daemon is below the minimum supported version. A required update cannot be dismissed and blocks new connections (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6452)
- Log panics to the app log file, flushing queued log lines when the main thread panics (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6673)

#### Changed

- Reword the daily-allowance limit error to point to Account Status (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6497)
- Update and improve error-message copy (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6748)

### 🍎 iOS & macOS apps

#### Added

- Show an update alert on iOS and macOS when below the minimum supported version. A required update blocks new connections, including from the menu bar (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6453)

#### Changed

- iOS: free trial offered only to eligible Nym accounts (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6701)
- Update and improve error-message copy (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6750)

#### Fixed

- Show the daily allowance reset time, including time of day, in the local time zone (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6497)
- Persist the network-stats preference consistently, including on iOS (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6469)

name: v2026.13.0
body:
Nym VPN v2026.13.0 application and core binaries.

## 🚀 What's New
### 🛠️ Core

#### Added

- Detect when the diagnostics check should be run (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/5993)
- Persist gateway list to disk, seeded from a built-in list (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6015)
- [Linux] Authenticate also via UNIX group "nym-vpn" membership, or root (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6100)
- Configuration profiles: Safest, Most Private, Fastest and Random (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6073)
- Add `six_months` subscription kind to the vpn-api models and gRPC proto (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6320)
- Add end-to-end plumbing for dynamically applying DNS fallbacks from Discovery (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6126)
- [Desktop] Detect conflicting software and report it to the user (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6122). Temporarily disabled, as it falsely reports DNS interception on systemd-resolved systems

#### Changed

- [macOS] Sign cli with net.nymtech.vpn.cli bundle identifier. Add it to client signing requirement. (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/5998)
- Merge rpc-uniffi crate into lib-uniffi (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6010)
- Fallback to random when no location data available (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6382)
- Re-order authentication flow and do checks as soon as possible (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6406)

#### Fixed

- Run diagnostics in the background so a slow one no longer blocks other commands, such as disconnect
- Remove a gateway from the blacklist once a tunnel through it connects, so a working server is not hidden from the server list
- Only report connected once both the in-tunnel ping and the gateway metadata check pass, and tear down the tunnel when the ping check fails (removes the metadata-based teardown deferral from #5762 and the connect-on-healthy-metadata fallback from #6091)
- Keep the cached gateway list on the first connect and when a discovery refresh updates the current network, instead of refetching it
- Keep the in-flight location lookup instead of restarting it on each connect or settings update, so automatic gateway selection is less likely to fall back to random
- Treat a built-in or unknown-age gateway cache as stale on startup so a fresh list is fetched (including an on-disk cache older than the Windows system uptime)
- Remove failed pending requests before creating new ones (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6295)
- [macOS] Fix file permissions for `nym-vpnc` in the macOS installer package, helping ensure the installed application can run correctly (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6456)
- Auto selection no longer treats US states as separate jurisdictions: "exclude my country" and the entry/exit country check now compare whole countries only

### 🤖 Android app

#### Added
- Changelog validation workflow for Play Store (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6128)
- Profiles: UI and logic (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6144)
- Set geo location for android command sender (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6144)
- Log prior process exit reasons on startup (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6236)
- Add Profiles screen to Settings (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6319)
- Six-month subscription kind with long-plan expiry warnings (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6320)
- Add error handling for Connect button (http://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6329)
- Enable ARM Memory Tagging Extension (MTE) in async mode (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6436)
- Log out asks every time whether the passphrase is saved (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6480)
- Screen lock confirmation for passphrase, subscription, social login and shortcuts (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6504)
- Screen lock required for account creation (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6504)
- Block screenshots on passphrase/PIN screens (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6562)
- Clear copied passphrase/PIN after 60s (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6562)

#### Changed
- Maestro UI suite: repair the five flows broken by the dVPN rename, the Connection profiles settings row and the Passphrase download removal; replace assertions that could not fail; correct mock gateway uptime to a 0-1 fraction
- Remove score placeholder. Update animation (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6231)
- Bump toolchain version to 25 (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6296)
- Bump detekt (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6296)
- Separate workflow for Play Store metadata (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6411)
- Disable default PII in Sentry (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6440)
- Disable view hierarchy attachment in Sentry (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6533)
- Remove unused libs (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6442)
- Update notifications security (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6444)
- Remove camera usage (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6449)
- Download function removed from Passphrase screen (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6460)
- Remove unused permissions (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6479)
- Dismissible screen lock alert on Main Screen (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6562)
- Unify nav transitions and fix predictive back flash (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6647)

#### Fixed
- Prefer validated WiFi or Ethernet over cellular when binding the VPN process on the cover TUN
- Fail cover TUN setup if bindProcessToNetwork returns false instead of logging success
- Proper status handling for Notification Manager (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6268)
- Fix Quick Tile crash after service destroy (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6232)
- Disable Sentry Session Replay to stop foreground ANR kills (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6248)
- Fail tunnel configure if the VPN app cannot be excluded from the blocking interface (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6213)
- Fix NavComponent crash after libs version update (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6442)
- Screen lock confirmation on Android 7–10 devices with only a PIN, pattern or password (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6504)
- Fix grey nav bar on bottom sheets (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6562)
- Fix TechOptView transition (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6647)

### 🐧🪟 Windows & Linux apps

#### Added

- Connection profiles: Auto, Anonymous, Fastest and Random (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6141, https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6314)
- Recently used servers (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6118)
- Upcoming-expiry renewal reminder (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6512)
- Mixnet tuning: cover-traffic toggle and tuning slider (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6598)
- Italian and Indonesian locales (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6327)

#### Changed

- Rename "Safest" to "Auto" (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6424)
- Beta pill on the App & Wallet proxy setting (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6409)

#### Fixed

- (windows) Fix `cannot move state from Destroyed` panic on shutdown, logoff or Restart Manager close by bumping tauri to 2.12.1 (tao 0.37) (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6617)

### 🍎 iOS & macOS apps

#### Added

- Six-month subscription kind (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6320)
- Add Profiles: UI & logic (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6364)
- Upcoming-expiry renewal reminder (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6507)
- Mixnet tuning: cover-traffic toggle and tuning slider (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6596)
- Italian and Indonesian locales (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6327)

#### Changed

- Rename "Safest" to "Auto" (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6424)

#### Removed

- Widget support for both iOS & macOS (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6255)

name: v2026.12.4
body:
Nym VPN v2026.12.4 application and core binaries.

## 🚀 What's New
### 🛠️ Core

#### Added

- Respect the gateway blacklist for "pinned gateways" (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6272)

#### Fixed

- [iOS] Do not bind LAN custom DNS upstreams to the tunnel interface
- Bump nym `vpn/release/2026.14-amsterdam` to include LP registration clock-skew stamps (https://github.com/nymtech/nym/pull/7150)
- [macOS] After disconnect, restore DNS and the physical default route and do not re-apply the kill-switch when already disconnected. (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6261)
- Apply the kill-switch when Connect is pressed while still offline. (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6265)
- Give slow exit handshakes headroom before failing the connection (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6237)
- Retry zk-nym credential requests when upstream is unavailable mid-ceremony (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6258)
- Prevent gateway refresh storm when the API is unreachable (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6087)
- [Windows] Wait for the VPN service to be running after install (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6245)
- Avoid blocking daemon command loop when handling recents which may perform network calls (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6294)
- [Android] Don't use `reqwest` HTTP client to avoid `rustls-platform-verifier` panic (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6316)
- [Android] Keep a blocking VPN interface up on connect, reconnect, error, offline, and unexpected tunnel down so other apps cannot leak to the ISP. The VPN app is excluded so gateway registration still works. (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6213) 

#### Removed

- Removed the wireguard tunnel handshake checks (https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client/pull/6342)

### 🐧🪟 Windows & Linux apps

#### Fixed

- Replace lottie animations with manual css animations
